vtubestudio.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to VTube Studio.

vtubestudio.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to VTube Studio, for example when you close it.

vtubestudio.modelLoaded.description: Runs when a model (your avatar) is loaded in VTube Studio.

fields.modelName: Only react to these models, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any model.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model

vtubestudio.modelUnloaded.description: Runs when the model (your avatar) is unloaded from VTube Studio.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model

vtubestudio.hotkeyTriggered.description: Runs when a VTube Studio hotkey is used, for example to change an expression or play an animation.

fields.hotkeyName: Only react to these hotkeys, typed by name or id. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any hotkey.
fields.hotkeyAction: Only react to this kind of hotkey, like "ToggleExpression" or "TriggerAnimation". Leave empty for any kind.
fields.ignoreApi: Tick to ignore hotkeys that other programs (including Cuebot) triggered, so only hotkeys you press yourself count.

variables.hotkeyFile: The file the hotkey uses, if any
variables.triggeredByApi: True if another program triggered it
variables.modelName: The model it was used on

vtubestudio.trackingStatusChanged.description: Runs when VTube Studio's face or hand tracking changes (found or lost).

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.trackingLost.description: Runs when VTube Studio can no longer see your face. Good for a "brb" reaction.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.trackingFound.description: Runs when VTube Studio sees your face again after losing it.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.backgroundChanged.description: Runs when you switch the background in VTube Studio.

fields.backgroundName: Only react to these backgrounds, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any background.

variables.backgroundName: The name of the new background

vtubestudio.modelConfigChanged.description: Runs when the settings of the loaded model change in VTube Studio, for example when you edit its hotkeys.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.hotkeyConfigChanged: True if the hotkey list changed

vtubestudio.modelMoved.description: Runs when the model is moved, turned or resized in VTube Studio.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is left edge, 1 is right edge)
variables.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is bottom, 1 is top)
variables.rotation: How far it is turned, in degrees

vtubestudio.modelAnimation.description: Runs when an animation on the model starts, ends or sends a custom signal.

fields.animationEventType: Start reacts when an animation begins, End when it finishes, Custom for special signals set inside the animation, Any for all.
fields.animationName: Only react to these animations, typed by name. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any animation.
fields.ignoreIdle: Tick to ignore the animations the model plays by itself while doing nothing (idle animations).
fields.animationEventData: Only react to custom signals with this text (the text you gave the event in the Cubism Animator). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.animationLength: How long the animation lasts, in seconds
variables.isIdleAnimation: True if it is an idle animation

vtubestudio.itemEvent.description: Runs when something happens to an item (a prop or picture in your VTube Studio scene), like being added, removed or clicked.

fields.itemEventType: Which kind of thing to react to. Pick Any to react to all of them.
fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.itemAdded.description: Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is added to your VTube Studio scene.

fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.itemRemoved.description: Runs when an item (a prop or picture) is removed from your VTube Studio scene.

fields.itemFileName: Only react to these item files (the picture or prop file names, like "star.png"). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any item.

variables.itemEventType: What happened to the item: Added, Removed, Clicked and so on
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of this copy of the item
variables.itemX: Where the item is, left to right
variables.itemY: Where the item is, bottom to top

vtubestudio.modelClicked.description: Runs when someone clicks in the VTube Studio window, for example on your model.

fields.mouseButton: Only react to this mouse button, or pick Any.
fields.onlyOnModel: Tick to only react when the click lands on the model. Untick to react to clicks anywhere.
fields.artMeshes: Only react to clicks on these parts of the model, by ArtMesh id (for example the head, for headpats). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for anywhere.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.modelWasClicked: True if the click hit the model
variables.clickY: Where the click landed, up or down
variables.clickedArtMeshCount: How many parts of the model were hit
variables.artMeshId: The id of the topmost part of the model under the click
variables.artMeshIds: Every part of the model under the click, separated by commas

vtubestudio.expressionToggled.description: Runs when an expression (a face or pose preset) is switched on or off in VTube Studio.

fields.expressionName: Only react to these expressions, typed by name or file. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any expression.
fields.stateFilter: Pick On to react when it turns on, Off when it turns off, or Any for both.
fields.source: React to expressions of your model, of Live2D items you loaded, or both.
fields.ignoreSnapshots: Tick to ignore the full list VTube Studio sends when a model loads (one message per expression). Untick to react to those too.

variables.modelId: VTube Studio's id for the model
variables.active: True when the expression is now on
variables.justLoaded: True when the message is part of the list sent when a model loads, not a change
variables.isLive2DItem: True when the expression belongs to a Live2D item
variables.itemInstanceId: The id of that Live2D item, if any

vtubestudio.postProcessingChanged.description: Runs when VTube Studio's visual effects (post-processing) are turned on or off or their preset changes.

fields.postProcessingPreset: Only react when one of these presets is in use. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any change.

variables.postProcessingOn: True when visual effects are on
variables.postProcessingPreset: The name of the preset in use

vtubestudio.event.description: Runs for any message VTube Studio sends, so you can react to things Cuebot has no special trigger for. For advanced users.

fields.eventName: Only react to these kinds of VTube Studio messages, like "ModelMovedEvent". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for all.

variables.eventName: The kind of VTube Studio message
variables.data: All the details of the message, as raw text

vtubestudio.handLost.description: Runs when VTube Studio stops seeing one of your hands (hand tracking).

fields.hand: React to the left hand, the right hand, or either.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.handFound.description: Runs when VTube Studio sees one of your hands again (hand tracking).

fields.hand: React to the left hand, the right hand, or either.

variables.faceFound: True if a face is being tracked
variables.leftHandFound: True if the left hand is tracked
variables.rightHandFound: True if the right hand is tracked

vtubestudio.cubismEditorConnection.description: Runs when VTube Studio connects to or disconnects from the Live2D Cubism Editor (for model makers testing their model live).

variables.tryingToConnect: True while VTube Studio tries to connect
variables.shouldSendParameters: True when VTube Studio sends tracking to the editor

vtubestudio.triggerHotkey.description: Presses a VTube Studio hotkey for you, for example to play an animation or change an expression.

fields.hotkey: The hotkey name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.itemInstanceId: Only for hotkeys that belong to a Live2D item you loaded: the id of that item. Most people can leave this empty.

variables.vtsHotkeyId: The id of the hotkey that was triggered

vtubestudio.loadModel.description: Switches VTube Studio to another model (avatar).

fields.model: The model name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsModelId: The id of the model that was loaded

vtubestudio.moveModel.description: Moves, turns or resizes your model on screen, smoothly.

fields.time: How long the move takes, in seconds (0 to 2).
fields.relative: Tick to move from where the model is now. Untick to put it at exactly the numbers below.
fields.positionX: Left to right: -1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.positionY: Bottom to top: -1 is the bottom, 1 is the top. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees (-360 to 360). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.size: How big it is (-100 to 100). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

vtubestudio.setExpression.description: Turns an expression (a face or pose preset) on or off.

fields.expression: The expression name or file as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.state: On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips it.
fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, in seconds.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsExpressionActive: True if the expression is on afterwards

vtubestudio.removeAllExpressions.description: Turns off every expression that is currently on.

fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, in seconds.

vtubestudio.injectParameters.description: Moves parts of your model yourself, like head angle or mouth opening, as if your face did it. Handy for scripted reactions.

fields.parameters: What to move, as name=value, separated by commas or new lines, like "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1". Add @ and a number for how strongly, like "MouthOpen=1@0.5".
fields.mode: set replaces the value, add adds to what your face tracking is doing.
fields.holdSeconds: How long to keep the values applied, in seconds. Cuebot keeps re-sending them until the time is over.
fields.faceFound: Tick to tell VTube Studio a face was found, so it does not show "tracking lost" while Cuebot controls the model.

vtubestudio.colorTint.description: Tints your model with a color, for example red when someone is angry. Can tint all of it or only some parts.

fields.color: The color as a hex code like #FF8080, or as numbers like "255,128,128" (red, green, blue, and optional see-through).
fields.nameContains: Only tint parts whose ArtMesh names contain this text. Separate several with commas. Leave every filter empty to tint the whole model.
fields.tagContains: Only tint parts whose tags contain these words. Separate several with commas.
fields.mix: How much the tint mixes with the scene lighting, from 0 to 1.
fields.nameExact: Only tint parts with exactly these ArtMesh ids. Separate several with commas.
fields.tagExact: Only tint parts with exactly these tags. Separate several with commas.
fields.groups: Only tint the parts in these ArtMesh groups (the groups you made in VTube Studio), by name. Separate several with commas.
fields.numbers: Only tint the parts at these positions in the model, like 1, 3, 5.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until the colors go back to how they were. Leave empty to keep the tint.

variables.vtsMatchedArtMeshes: How many parts of the model were tinted

vtubestudio.resetColorTint.description: Removes all color tints from your model.

vtubestudio.loadItem.description: Puts an item (a prop or picture) into your VTube Studio scene.

fields.fileName: The item's file name as VTube Studio shows it, like "star.png".
fields.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge).
fields.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top).
fields.size: How big it is, from 0 to 1.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees.
fields.fadeTime: How long it takes to fade in, in seconds.
fields.order: Which layer it sits on, from -30 to 30. Leave empty to let VTube Studio pick a free one.
fields.unloadOnDisconnect: Tick to remove the item automatically if Cuebot disconnects from VTube Studio (recommended, so items never get stuck).
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the item's id, so you can move or remove it later. The default is vtsItemInstanceId.
fields.image: A picture to load instead of an item file: a web address, a file on this computer, or base64 data, like %userProfileImageUrl%. The first time, VTube Studio asks you to allow Cuebot to load pictures.
fields.askFirst: Tick to have VTube Studio ask you before showing a picture it hasn't seen yet.
fields.pin: Pin the item to your model so it moves with it, and where.
fields.pinArtMesh: The part of the model (ArtMesh id) to pin to, for the ArtMesh choices.
fields.locked: Tick so the item can't be dragged with the mouse.
fields.smoothing: How smoothly the item follows when it moves, from 0 to 1.
fields.unloadAfter: Seconds until the item is removed again. Leave empty to keep it.

variables.vtsItemInstanceId: The id of the new item (or the name you chose above)

vtubestudio.unloadItem.description: Removes items (props or pictures) from your VTube Studio scene.

fields.item: The items to remove, by id or file name. Separate several with commas.
fields.all: Tick to remove every item in the scene.
fields.onlyCuebot: Tick to remove every item Cuebot put into the scene (and nothing you added yourself).

vtubestudio.moveItem.description: Moves, turns or resizes an item in your scene, smoothly.

fields.item: The item's id or file name. A file name moves every copy of it. Separate several with commas.
fields.time: How long the move takes, in seconds.
fields.fadeMode: How the motion feels: linear is steady, easeIn starts slow, easeOut ends slow, easeBoth does both, overshoot goes past and bounces back, zip is a quick snap.
fields.positionX: Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.positionY: Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.size: How big it is, from 0 to 1. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.order: Move the item to this layer, from -30 to 30 (the spot must be free). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.flip: Mirror the item, un-mirror it, or leave it as it is.

vtubestudio.getCurrentModel.description: Reads which model is loaded and where it is, and keeps the details for later steps.

variables.vtsModelLoaded: True if a model is loaded

vtubestudio.getModels.description: Reads the list of models you have in VTube Studio and keeps it for later steps.

variables.vtsModels: All model names, separated by commas
variables.vtsModelsJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.getHotkeys.description: Reads the hotkeys of the loaded model and keeps them for later steps.

fields.model: Another model to list the hotkeys of, by name. Leave empty for the current model.
fields.live2DItem: A Live2D item to list the hotkeys of, by file name. Leave empty for the model.

variables.vtsHotkeys: All hotkey names, separated by commas
variables.vtsHotkeysJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.getExpressions.description: Reads the expressions of the loaded model and which ones are on, and keeps them for later steps.

variables.vtsExpressions: All expression names, separated by commas
variables.vtsActiveExpressions: The names of the expressions that are on now
variables.vtsExpressionsJson: The full list as raw text

vtubestudio.rawRequest.description: Sends VTube Studio one request of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know the VTube Studio plugin commands.

fields.messageType: The VTube Studio request name, like "SceneColorOverlayInfoRequest".
fields.data: Extra details for the request, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer as text. The default is vtsResult.
fields.variablePrefix: Also keeps each part of the answer as its own variable starting with this word, like %vtsRaw.data.modelName%. Leave empty to skip.

variables.vtsResult: The whole answer as raw text (or the name you chose above)

vtubestudio.changeModel.description: Switches to the next, previous or a random other model, or unloads the model.

fields.change: Which model to switch to, or Unload to show none.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsModelName: The name of the model now loaded (empty after unloading)

vtubestudio.loadVfxPreset.description: Turns on one of the visual effects presets you saved in VTube Studio, like a rain or glitch look.

fields.preset: The preset name as VTube Studio shows it.
fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, from 0 to 2 seconds.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsVfxOn: True when visual effects are on
variables.vtsVfxPreset: The preset in use, if any

vtubestudio.setVfx.description: Turns VTube Studio's visual effects on or off, keeping their settings.

fields.state: Turn on, turn off, or switch.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsVfxOn: True when visual effects are now on

vtubestudio.setVfxValues.description: Changes single visual effect settings, like the bloom strength or a color.

fields.values: Settings as name=value, like Bloom_Strength=0.8. Colors are written as RRGGBBAA. Separate several with commas or new lines.
fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, from 0 to 2 seconds.
fields.othersToDefault: Tick to turn every other effect off.
fields.restricted: Tick if you use effects VTube Studio marks as restricted (you must allow them in VTube Studio first).
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsVfxOn: True when visual effects are on
variables.vtsVfxPreset: The preset in use, if any

vtubestudio.randomizeVfx.description: Picks random visual effects, just for fun.

fields.chaos: How wild it gets, from 0 (calm) to 1 (chaos).
fields.fadeTime: How long the change takes, from 0 to 2 seconds.
fields.revertAfter: Seconds until Cuebot puts it back the way it was. Leave empty to keep the change.

variables.vtsVfxOn: True when visual effects are on
variables.vtsVfxPreset: The preset in use, if any

vtubestudio.getVfx.description: Reads whether visual effects are on and which preset is in use.

fields.refreshPresets: Tick to read the list of presets again (VTube Studio reads it from disk).

variables.vtsVfxOn: True when visual effects are on
variables.vtsVfxPreset: The preset in use, if any
variables.vtsVfxPresets: Every preset you saved, separated by commas

vtubestudio.throwItems.description: Throws items or pictures at your model: they fly in from a side, a corner or the camera, your model flinches, and they fall away and disappear.

fields.files: Item files to throw. Separate several with commas; one is picked at random for each throw.
fields.images: Or pictures to throw instead, like %userProfileImageUrl% (web addresses, files or base64). The first time, VTube Studio asks you to allow Cuebot to load pictures.
fields.size: How big each one is, from 0 to 1.
fields.flightTime: Seconds each one takes to reach the model.
fields.flinch: How hard your model reacts, from 0 (not at all) to 1.
fields.from: Where they fly in from: a side, a corner, Front (from the camera), Random: left or right (the old choice), or Random: any direction for a different direction each throw.
fields.askFirst: Tick to have VTube Studio ask you before showing a picture it hasn't seen yet.

vtubestudio.pinItem.description: Pins an item to your model so it moves with it, like a hat on the head.

fields.item: The item's id or file name. A file name pins every copy.
fields.place: Where to pin it: somewhere random, an ArtMesh, or where the model was last clicked.
fields.artMesh: The part of the model (ArtMesh id), for the ArtMesh choices.
fields.angle: The angle in degrees, relative to the model. Leave empty to keep the item's rotation.
fields.size: The size from 0 to 1. Leave empty to keep it.

vtubestudio.unpinItem.description: Unpins an item from your model.

fields.item: The item's id or file name. A file name unpins every copy.

vtubestudio.getItems.description: Lists the items in your VTube Studio scene.

fields.includeFiles: Tick to also read the list of item files again (VTube Studio may stutter for a moment).

variables.vtsItemCount: How many items are in the scene
variables.vtsItems: Their file names, separated by commas
variables.vtsItemsJson: Every item with its details, as JSON
variables.vtsItem0.instanceId: The first item's id (vtsItem1.instanceId for the second, and so on)
variables.vtsItem0.pinned: True if the first item is pinned to the model
variables.vtsItemFiles: Every item file, when you ticked the box

vtubestudio.itemAnimation.description: Changes how a picture or animated item looks: see-through, darker, faster or slower, or a set frame. Doesn't work on Live2D items.

fields.item: The item's id or file name.
fields.opacity: From 0 (invisible) to 1. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.brightness: From 0 (black) to 1. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.framerate: Animation speed in frames per second. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.frame: Jump to this frame (0 is the first). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.play: Play or stop the animation, or leave it.
fields.autoStopFrames: Frame numbers where the animation stops by itself, separated by commas. Type none to clear them. Leave empty to keep them.

variables.vtsItemFrame: The frame the animation is on
variables.vtsItemPlaying: True when the animation is playing

vtubestudio.sortItem.description: Puts an item between your model's layers, for example behind the hair but in front of the face.

fields.item: The item's id or file name.
fields.front: The part of the model (ArtMesh id) the item goes in front of, or FullyInFront / FullyInBack. Leave empty to take the item out of the model's layers.
fields.back: Live2D items only: where the item's back part goes.
fields.splitAt: Live2D items only: the item's own ArtMesh where it is split into a front and back part.

vtubestudio.rainbowTint.description: Cycles your model through the colors of the rainbow for a while, then puts the colors back.

fields.cycleSeconds: Seconds for one trip through every color.
fields.mix: How much the color replaces VTube Studio's scene lighting, from 0 to 1.
fields.nameContains: Only parts whose ArtMesh names contain this text. Leave every filter empty for the whole model.
fields.tagContains: Only parts whose tags contain this text.
fields.nameExact: Only parts with exactly these ArtMesh ids.
fields.tagExact: Only parts with exactly these tags.
fields.groups: Only the parts in these ArtMesh groups, by name.
fields.numbers: Only the parts at these positions in the model, like 1, 3, 5.

vtubestudio.pickArtMeshes.description: Opens a list in VTube Studio where you pick parts of your model; Cuebot waits until you click OK.

fields.text: The message shown above the list in VTube Studio.
fields.count: How many parts must be picked. 0 lets you pick any number.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the picked ArtMesh ids. The default is vtsArtMeshes.

variables.vtsArtMeshes: The picked ArtMesh ids, separated by commas (empty if you clicked Cancel)

vtubestudio.getArtMeshes.description: Lists the parts (ArtMeshes), tags and groups of your model.

variables.vtsArtMeshes: Every ArtMesh id, separated by commas

vtubestudio.createParameter.description: Adds a new tracking parameter that your model can react to, like a heart rate or a goal's progress. Cuebot creates it again every time it connects.

fields.name: 4 to 32 letters and digits, no spaces, like CuebotHeartRate.
fields.explanation: A short note shown in VTube Studio.
fields.default: The value when nothing sets it.

vtubestudio.deleteParameter.description: Removes a tracking parameter Cuebot created.

vtubestudio.setParameter.description: Sets a tracking parameter and keeps it there (Cuebot keeps sending it) until you set it again or stop it. Good for values that change now and then, like a heart rate.

fields.parameter: The parameter's name, like FaceAngleX or one you created.
fields.weight: From 0 to 1: how much it overrides face tracking. Leave empty to override fully.
fields.seconds: How long to keep it. Leave empty to keep it until it is set again or stopped.

vtubestudio.stopParameter.description: Stops keeping a parameter set, so face tracking takes over again.

fields.parameter: The parameter's name. Leave empty to stop every parameter Cuebot keeps.

vtubestudio.physics.description: Turns up the physics (bouncing hair and clothes) or the wind for a while.

fields.strength: Physics strength from 0 to 100 for the whole model, or a multiplier from 0 to 2 with groups. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.wind: Wind from 0 to 100 for the whole model, or a multiplier from 0 to 2 with groups. Leave empty to keep it.
fields.groups: Only these physics groups, by name. Leave empty for the whole model.

variables.vtsHasPhysics: True if the model has physics
variables.vtsPhysicsOn: True if physics are switched on

vtubestudio.requestPermission.description: Asks VTube Studio to allow Cuebot something extra; VTube Studio shows a popup for you to answer.

fields.permission: LoadCustomImagesAsItems lets Cuebot show pictures (like profile pictures) as items. ControlNDISettings lets Cuebot turn NDI output on and off.

variables.vtsPermissionGranted: True when VTube Studio allowed it

vtubestudio.ndi.description: Turns VTube Studio's NDI video output on or off. The first time, VTube Studio asks you to allow it.

fields.state: Turn on, turn off, or switch.
fields.width: A fixed width (a multiple of 16). Leave empty to keep it.
fields.height: A fixed height (a multiple of 8). Leave empty to keep it.

variables.vtsNdiOn: True when NDI output is now on

vtubestudio.getStatistics.description: Reads VTube Studio's version, frame rate, window size and how long it has been running.

variables.vtsFullscreen: True when the window is fullscreen

vtubestudio.getSceneLighting.description: Reads the color VTube Studio's scene lighting picks up from your screen, for example to match your room lights to it.

variables.vtsLightingOn: True when scene lighting is on
variables.vtsOverlayR: The red part of the final overlay (up to 459)
variables.vtsOverlayG: The green part of the final overlay
variables.vtsOverlayB: The blue part of the final overlay

vtubestudio.getTracking.description: Checks whether VTube Studio sees your face and hands right now.

variables.vtsFaceFound: True if your face is tracked
variables.vtsLeftHandFound: True if your left hand is tracked
variables.vtsRightHandFound: True if your right hand is tracked
